summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Easy Ventures marketing site. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (health, contact valid/invalid/full, newsletter valid+duplicate+invalid). Frontend: hero, nav smooth-scroll, brand cards expand + learn more, culture lightbox open/close, see-full-team toast, contact form (empty error toast + valid success toast + form cleared), newsletter subscribe toast — all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured, uses env vars, excludes _id, and SMTP degrades gracefully as required.
Consider adding lowercase normalization + unique index on newsletter_subscribers.email to prevent race-condition duplicates under concurrency (currently uses find_one check only).
ContactSubmission.email uses EmailStr which is fine; created_at stored as ISO string — consistent.
seed_data_creation: Test contact submissions and newsletter subscribers with TEST_/test_ email prefixes were created during test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse as regression. Public URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Contact toast text: 'Thank you! Your message has been received.' Newsletter first: 'Subscribed! Check your inbox.', duplicate: contains 'already'. Lenis smooth scroll — use scroll_into_view_if_needed with ~500ms waits before interacting with elements below the fold.
